integrity: All theorems are proved in the associated RESULT.md. The bundled finite-model verifier corroborates small instances and numerical limits but cannot prove unrestricted asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Square-zero elements only; distinct fixed-block and factorial-critical regimes. The unblocked central-trinomial specialization and prior work on nilpotents are not claimed as new. An exact generalized-trinomial representation is classical. Some older papers could only be inspected through abstracts; priority is not independently established.
title: Square-zero block injections: exact rank census and a parity-Poisson transition
